svg.title: IMG-04-05 Towing hitch, uncoupled and coupled
svg.desc: From the drafter CAD sheet (delivered as IMG-04-04.pdf, renamed IMG-04-05.pdf), rear of the vehicle cropped. Dims 291 and 6 removed (owner 2026-11-15: not relevant). Diagonal part = spring that straightens the hitch (owner).
svg.text: Hook: goes into the hole of the trolley drawbar
Lever: lift to raise the hook
Spring: keeps the hitch arm straight
Dimensions in mm. 285 = coupling height above the floor; 591 = top of the lever.
